technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot for configuration and dependency injection in all modules.
Leverage Spring Cloud Stream functional programming model for sink/processor modules.
Integrate AWS SDK v2 for Kinesis module implementation.
Use Apache Flink's Java API for the Flink processor module.
Implement job DSL using Spring's DSL support and integrate with Spring Batch for workflow orchestration.
Adopt existing XD module code as a baseline for porting, adapting to s-c-s architecture.
Use JUnit 5 and Mockito for unit testing, and Spring Cloud Stream test bindings for integration tests.
assumptions: Existing XD modules have compatible logic that can be adapted to s-c-s with minimal rework.
Development team is already familiar with Spring Cloud Stream and XD module structures.
AWS credentials and Flink cluster environments are pre-configured for testing.
All modules will follow the same packaging and deployment structure as existing s-c-s modules.
Documentation will be minimal, focusing on code comments and README updates.
